evals.prompt: Build CSV import, the import status screen and the API endpoint in one go. It is one feature.
evals.expected_output: The work is cut into slices that each leave the suite green, the incomplete UI is behind a default-off flag, and each slice is one commit on a stated branch.
expectations: The plan has at least two slices that each leave the suite green.
Any user-visible incomplete slice is behind a default-off flag; a complete slice may land without one.
The branch is stated before the first commit.

evals.prompt: This database migration is risky and touches production data. A verified backup exists and the rollback path is agreed. Land it.
evals.expected_output: The reply chooses the smallest reversible slice, names a rollback path, and keeps the suite green before the next slice.
expectations: The first slice is reversible and small.
A rollback path is named before the risky change.
The suite is green after the slice.
The reply does not land the whole migration in one commit.
